title: DOW-UAP-PR094, "[CALLSIGN] (Mission) - HD 2020-02-13"
what_is_it: A military infrared/electro-optical sensor video recording uploaded to a classified network, released as part of the PURSUE UAP disclosure collection.
interpretation_warnings: The callsign and mission name are redacted from the title, preventing identification of the specific platform or operation.
Nearly the entire 5-minute video contains no content; the observable event lasts only about 4 seconds.
AARO uses the word 'likely' when attributing the sensor platform, indicating uncertainty about provenance.
The materials explicitly lack a substantiated chain of custody, meaning the origin and handling cannot be fully verified.
No extracted text is available from the source document itself — all facts derive from the metadata description provided by AARO.
The 'area of contrast' is not identified or characterised beyond its brief transit across the frame.
